annotations.title: OpenAI Responses API compatible text generation

description: OpenAI Responses API compatible text generation — Drop-in OpenAI Responses API (POST /v1/responses) backed by Llama 3.3 70B on Workers AI. Body JSON: input (string, or array of {role, content} messages where content is a string or [{type:input_text,text}]), optional instructions, max_output_tokens (16-4096, default 1024), temperature, top_p, metadata. Returns the standard response object with output[0].content[0].output_text, a top-level output_text convenience field and token usage. developer role maps to system; images and tools are ignored; stream is not supported. Failed model calls return 502 and are never charged. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).

input.description: Write a two-sentence product update announcing faster API responses.
